scripts.dev: sh -c 'PY=${VIRTUAL_ENV:+$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python}; PY=${PY:-$(command -v .venv/bin/python || command -v python3)}; exec $PY -m uvicorn scraper.main:app --app-dir src --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${SCRAPER_PORT:-8001}'
scripts.start: sh -c 'PY=${VIRTUAL_ENV:+$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/python}; PY=${PY:-$(command -v .venv/bin/python || command -v python3)}; exec $PY -m uvicorn scraper.main:app --app-dir src --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${SCRAPER_PORT:-8001}'
scripts.lint: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff check src tests; elif command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check src tests; else python3 -m py_compile src/scraper/main.py; fi'
scripts.build: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q src; else python3 -m compileall -q src; fi'
